sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，体内血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字——阿达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但查出她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: And City Attorney James O'Leary was in his office on Tuesday July 27, 1976, when a man and woman entered wishing to speak to him.
sentences.zh: 1976年7月27日星期二，市检察官詹姆斯·奥利里正在办公室里，这时一男一女走了进来，说要找他谈谈。

sentences.en: Dishevelled and exhausted, they had just emerged from the Mount Hood National Forest after a weekend spent camping and fishing in the wilderness.
sentences.zh: 他们衣衫褴褛、筋疲力尽，刚刚走出胡德山国家森林，此前他们在那片荒野中露营和钓鱼度过了周末。

sentences.en: They planned to speak to the police regarding a tragedy that had happened there, but were apprehensive about doing so without seeking legal advice firSt.
sentences.zh: 他们本打算就那里发生的一起悲剧报警，但在未寻求法律咨询之前，他们对直接报警感到十分忐忑。

sentences.en: After hearing their incredible story, James O'Leary escorted the distraught pair to the county sheriff's office.
sentences.zh: 听完他们匪夷所思的遭遇后，詹姆斯·奥利里亲自将这对心神不宁的夫妇送到了县治安官办公室。

sentences.en: When detectives asked why they hadn't come forward sooner, the man remarked,
sentences.zh: 当侦探询问他们为什么没有早点报案时，那名男子回答说：

sentences.en: I have a criminal record and I didn't want to face authorities.
sentences.zh: 我有犯罪前科，不想面对警方。

sentences.en: I was afraid they wouldn't believe me.
sentences.zh: 我担心他们不会相信我。

sentences.en: It was getting late on Friday, July 23, 1976.
sentences.zh: 那是1976年7月23日星期五的傍晚。

sentences.en: 29-year-old Tom Brown was driving his old red GMC pickup truck deep into the Mount Hood
sentences.zh: 29岁的汤姆·布朗驾驶着他那辆旧红色的 GMC 皮卡车，深入胡德山

sentences.en: National ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 国家森林。

sentences.en: By the time he reached the North Fork Dam on the Clackamas River, daylight was fading and there were very few people around.
sentences.zh: 当他到达克拉克马斯河上的北福克大坝时，天色已晚，周围几乎没什么人。

sentences.en: Tom brought his car to a stop near a boat launch area and left his engine running as he hurried over to a nearby fish ladder.
sentences.zh: 汤姆将车停在船只下水区附近，没熄火就急匆匆地跑向附近的一座鱼梯。

sentences.en: The long and narrow canal-like structure ran parallel to the river and was built to help fish migrate easily upstream.
sentences.zh: 这个长而窄的运河状结构与河流平行，旨在帮助鱼类轻松向上游洄游。

sentences.en: Tom was standing alone observing the water when a young man approached and started talking to him.
sentences.zh: 汤姆独自站在那里观察水流时，一个年轻男子走了过来并开始跟他搭话。

sentences.en: His name was Julio Torres and he was camping in the forest with his wife for their one-year wedding anniversary.
sentences.zh: 他叫胡利奥·托雷斯，正和妻子在森林里露营，庆祝他们结婚一周年。

sentences.en: An avid fisherman, Julio had been struggling to catch anything in the area and was seeking any possible advice from Tom.
sentences.zh: 作为一个狂热的钓鱼爱好者，胡利奥一直在当地一条鱼也钓不上来，于是向汤姆讨教任何可能的诀窍。

sentences.en: Tom was less than enthused by the interruption and made this clear by averting his gaze and giving curt responses.
sentences.zh: 汤姆对这种打扰毫无兴致，他把目光移开并敷衍了事，明确表现出这一点。

sentences.en: Julio persisted.
sentences.zh: 胡利奥坚持不懈。

sentences.en: All we found were a couple of suckers, he told the disinterested Tom.
sentences.zh: 我们只抓到了几条吸盘鱼，他这样对毫无兴趣的汤姆说。

sentences.en: Minutes later, Julio's teenaged wife, Candra, appeared and joined in the conversation.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，胡利奥十几岁的妻子坎德拉出现了，也加入了他们的交谈。

sentences.en: Her presence loosened up the standoffish Tom, who managed to crack a smile.
sentences.zh: 她的出现让冷淡的汤姆放松了下来，他甚至挤出了一丝微笑。

sentences.en: Turning back to Julio, he finally offered some insider information to help the struggling couple.
sentences.zh: 他转过头看向胡利奥，终于透露了一些内部消息来帮助这对陷入困境的夫妇。

sentences.en: Earlier that day, he'd been doing some logging work in the forest when he saw a truckload of fish being offloaded into the river nearby.
sentences.zh: 就在当天早些时候，他一直在森林里进行伐木作业，当时他看到一卡车鱼被卸到了附近的一条河里。

sentences.en: Other fishermen Julio had spoken to throughout the day had also mentioned a fish dump and Julio was intrigued.
sentences.zh: 胡利奥这一天交谈过的其他渔民也提到过倾倒鱼群的事，这引起了胡利奥的兴趣。

sentences.en: That's where I'm headed, Tom told him.
sentences.zh: 我正要去那儿，汤姆告诉他。

sentences.en: Julio was keen to go there as well, but had driven his sedan down to just half a tank of gas.
sentences.zh: 胡利奥也很想去，但他的轿车油箱里只剩半箱油了。

sentences.en: Travelling further into the forest didn't seem wise.
sentences.zh: 再深入森林似乎不太明智。

sentences.en: Tom reassured him.
sentences.zh: 汤姆安慰他。

sentences.en: The fishing spot wasn't too far away and half a tank should get them there.
sentences.zh: 钓鱼点离这儿不远，半箱油应该够他们开到那儿了。

sentences.en: If Julio and Candra wound up stranded, Tom was willing to drop off some gas in the morning to get them moving again.
sentences.zh: 如果胡利奥和坎德拉最后被困住，汤姆愿意在早上送些汽油过去让他们重新上路。

sentences.en: The trio headed back to their respective cars.
sentences.zh: 三人各自回到了自己的车旁。

sentences.en: Tom drove off in the direction of the fishing spot and Julio, having weighed up the risks, followed behind.
sentences.zh: 汤姆朝着钓鱼点的方向开去，胡利奥权衡了风险后也开车跟了上去。

sentences.en: When Tom pulled over for a brief stop, so too did Julio.
sentences.zh: 当汤姆靠边短暂停留时，胡利奥也照做了。

sentences.en: The sedan's emptying fuel tank remained a concern, so Tom offered to drive Julio and Candra in his truck the remainder of the way to preserve what little gas they had.
sentences.zh: 轿车见底的油箱仍然是个隐患，于是汤姆主动提出用自己的卡车搭载胡利奥和坎德拉走完剩下的路，以节省他们所剩不多的汽油。

sentences.en: The couple declined the offer as they had been using their car to sleep in.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇拒绝了这个提议，因为他们一直把车当成睡觉的地方。

sentences.en: Where is this spot?
sentences.zh: 这个地方在哪？

sentences.en: Julio asked.
sentences.zh: 胡利奥问。

sentences.en: Just beyond Bagby Hot Springs Road, Tom explained, before returning to his truck and continuing onwards.
sentences.zh: 就在巴格比温泉路尽头不远，汤姆解释道，随后返回卡车继续前行。

sentences.en: The sedan tailed him once more.
sentences.zh: 轿车再次尾随其后。

sentences.en: By now, the road was curving deeper into more isolated areas of the foreSt.
sentences.zh: 此时，道路正向森林更深、更偏僻的区域蜿蜒而去。

sentences.en: Once on Bagby Hot Springs Road, the two-car convoy passed another vehicle travelling in the opposite direction with a father and daughter inside.
sentences.zh: 一上巴格比温泉路，这两辆车组成的队伍就与另一辆载着父女俩相向而行的车辆擦肩而过。

sentences.en: They encountered no one else.
sentences.zh: 他们没有遇到任何人。

sentences.en: Tom turned down an unpaved, bumpy logging road that snaked through the looming pine and fir trees.
sentences.zh: 汤姆拐进了一条未铺装、颠簸不平的伐木路，小路在若隐若现的松树和冷杉树间蜿蜒盘旋。

sentences.en: The sedan followed suit.
sentences.zh: 轿车也紧随其后。

sentences.en: By now, the sun had almost set, and Tom pulled over to set up camp for the night.
sentences.zh: 此时太阳已经快落山了，汤姆靠边停车准备扎营过夜。

sentences.en: Julio and Candra joined him.
sentences.zh: 胡利奥和坎德拉也加入了他的行列。

sentences.en: The couple were also travelling with their pet dog, a collie named Rusty, and as the sky darkened, the group settled around a fire to eat their dinner.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇还带着他们的宠物狗，一只名叫拉斯特的牧羊犬。随着天色暗下来，一行人围坐在火堆旁吃晚饭。

sentences.en: Tom drank some liquor, which he offered Julio and Candra, who each took a sip.
sentences.zh: 汤姆喝了一些烈酒，并拿出来请胡利奥和坎德拉喝，两人各自抿了一口。

sentences.en: After eating, Tom collected a rifle from his truck and set out to take a night walk in the surrounding woodland.
sentences.zh: 吃过饭后，汤姆从卡车里拿出一支步枪，出发去周边的林区进行夜间漫步。

sentences.en: Julio and Candra accompanied him on the short hike.
sentences.zh: 胡利奥和坎德拉陪着他进行了这次短途徒步。

sentences.en: Tom was familiar with the area and headed to a nearby meadow, explaining that he hunted deer there.
sentences.zh: 汤姆对这一带很熟悉，径直走向附近的一片草地，解释说他在那里猎鹿。

sentences.en: As they approached the clearing, Tom offered the couple his binoculars so they could observe several deer foraging up ahead.
sentences.zh: 当他们接近空地时，汤姆把自己的双筒望远镜递给这对夫妇，好让他们观察前方觅食的几头鹿。

sentences.en: A little further away from them, several bear cubs were playing.
sentences.zh: 离他们稍远一点的地方，几只小熊正在嬉戏玩耍。

sentences.en: Tom, Julio and Candra eventually returned to their camp, where they slept in their vehicles.
sentences.zh: 汤姆、胡利奥和坎德拉最终回到了营地，并在各自的车里睡下。

sentences.en: Tom woke first the following morning, at roughly 5am.
sentences.zh: 第二天清晨，汤姆醒得最早，大约在早上5点。

sentences.en: He wandered over to the sedan and banged on its hood to wake Julio and Candra, then the trio decided to try catching a fish for breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 他溜达到轿车旁，敲打着引擎盖叫醒了胡利奥和坎德拉，随后三人决定去钓条鱼当早餐。

sentences.en: Tom drove the others to another area of the forest before leading them on foot along an overgrown trail that led to the riverbank.
sentences.zh: 汤姆开车把其他人载到森林的另一个区域，然后带他们步行沿一条长满杂草的小路走到河岸。

sentences.en: Once there, Julio and Candra perched themselves on a rock.
sentences.zh: 到了那里，胡利奥和坎德拉在一块岩石上坐了下来。

sentences.en: Tom fished by himself a little further away.
sentences.zh: 汤姆则独自在稍远一点的地方钓鱼。

sentences.en: Time slipped by and nothing seemed to be biting.
sentences.zh: 时间悄然流逝，似乎没有什么鱼上钩。

sentences.en: Eventually, the group gave up and returned to their campsite empty-handed.
sentences.zh: 最终，大家放弃了，空手返回了营地。

sentences.en: There, Tom and Julio came up with a new plan.
sentences.zh: 在那里，汤姆和胡利奥想出了一个新计划。

sentences.en: They'd head back into the woods and try their luck at hunting some deer instead.
sentences.zh: 他们决定重返树林，碰碰运气看能不能猎到几头鹿。

sentences.en: Hunting was illegal in Oregon during the summer months, but that didn't dissuade them.
sentences.zh: 在俄勒冈州，夏季打猎是违法的，但这并没有阻止他们。

sentences.en: Tom had two rifles on him – a Winchester lever action and a .22 calibre Savage.
sentences.zh: 汤姆身上带着两支步枪——一支温彻斯特杠杆式步枪和一支.22口径的萨维奇步枪。

sentences.en: He handed one to Julio and kept the other for himself.
sentences.zh: 他把其中一支交给胡利奥，另一支留给自己。

sentences.en: Three days later, Tom Brown arrived at the office of Oregon City Attorney James O'Leary, where he announced that Julio Torres was dead.
sentences.zh: 三天后，汤姆·布朗来到俄勒冈市检察官詹姆斯·奥利里的办公室，宣布胡利奥·托雷斯已经死了。

sentences.en: Tom explained that he and Julio had been hunting in the Mount Hood National Forest when a terrible accident took place.
sentences.zh: 汤姆解释说，他和胡利奥在胡德山国家森林打猎时发生了一场可怕的意外。

sentences.en: Julio was scoping out the area with a pair of binoculars when he spotted a deer.
sentences.zh: 胡利奥正用双筒望远镜在区内搜索时发现了一头鹿。

sentences.en: Tom handed Julio his rifle to free up his hands so he too could have a look through the binoculars.
sentences.zh: 汤姆把自己的步枪递给胡利奥以解放他的双手，这样自己也可以用望远镜看看。

sentences.en: After observing the deer for himself, Tom decided he'd take a shot at it.
sentences.zh: 汤姆自己观察完那头鹿后，决定朝它开枪。

sentences.en: He returned the binoculars to Julio, who in turn handed Tom back his rifle.
sentences.zh: 他把望远镜还给胡利奥，胡利奥随即把步枪还给了汤姆。

sentences.en: As the Winchester was being passed between them, Tom grabbed the firearm's balance point with one finger on the trigger.
sentences.zh: 就在温彻斯特步枪在两人之间传递时，汤姆单指扣在扳机上抓住了枪支的平衡点。

sentences.en: Although he didn't pull it, the rifle fired mid-exchange.
sentences.zh: 尽管他没有扣动扳机，但在交接过程中枪还是走火了。

sentences.en: The single bullet penetrated Julio's head, killing him instantly.
sentences.zh: 单发子弹击中了胡利奥的头部，当场将他击毙。

sentences.en: Tom's shocking story was supported by the only other person with him that weekend – Candra Torres.
sentences.zh: 汤姆这起令人震惊的说法得到了那个周末陪同他的唯一另一个人——坎德拉·托雷斯的证实。

sentences.en: She had escorted Tom to James O'Leary's office to ensure he wouldn't be charged for a crime he didn't commit.
sentences.zh: 她陪同汤姆来到詹姆斯·奥利里的办公室，以确保他不会因为一场他并未犯下的罪行而被起诉。

sentences.en: Between sobs, Candra revealed that she had witnessed the shooting with her own eyes, as she was standing a couple of feet behind the two men when it happened.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉抽泣着透露，她亲眼目睹了枪击过程，因为事发时她就站在两名男子身后几英尺远的地方。

sentences.en: Her panicked screams had startled her pet dog, Rusty, who turned aggressive.
sentences.zh: 她惊恐的尖叫声惊吓了宠物狗拉斯特，它变得具有攻击性。

sentences.en: As Tom Brown rushed back to the campsite, Rusty ran at him, growling.
sentences.zh: 正当汤姆·布朗冲回营地时，拉斯特咆哮着向他冲了过来。

sentences.en: Certain the dog was about to attack, Tom scrambled his rifle into position and fired, killing the animal in self-defence.
sentences.zh: 汤姆确信这只狗要袭击他，于是慌忙端起步枪开火，出于自卫将动物击毙。

sentences.en: Later that day, Candra cried and nodded along as Tom repeated their story to detectives at the county sheriff's office.
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，当汤姆向县治安官办公室的侦探重复他们的说辞时，坎德拉一边哭泣一边连连点头。

sentences.en: When asked why they hadn't come forward sooner, Tom admitted that he was initially reluctant to go to the police due to the previous run-ins he'd had with the law.
sentences.zh: 当被问及为什么没有早点报案时，汤姆承认由于自己过去与警方有过节，起初很不情愿去找警察。

sentences.en: Tom had a string of offences listed against his name, most of which were petty and related to robbery.
sentences.zh: 汤姆名下有一连串的违法记录，其中大部分是与抢劫有关的轻微犯罪。

sentences.en: After accidentally killing Julio Torres, Tom sat in shock at the group's campsite, mulling over what to do next.
sentences.zh: 在意外杀死胡利奥·托雷斯后，汤姆惊恐万状地坐在营地里，琢磨着下一步该怎么办。

sentences.en: He was convinced that with his criminal record, officers would try to charge him with murder.
sentences.zh: 他确信以自己的犯罪前科，警官们会试图以谋杀罪起诉他。

sentences.en: I finally knew I had to split, that no one would believe me, Tom told detectives.
sentences.zh: 我当时终于明白我必须得跑，没有人会相信我，汤姆告诉侦探。

sentences.en: I told Candra she could do what she wanted, but that I was going to head to the mountains.
sentences.zh: 我告诉坎德拉她想怎么样都行，但我打算去山里。

sentences.en: She said I couldn't leave her there, that I had to take her back to civilisation, but I said no way, I'm going.
sentences.zh: 她说我不能把她留在那儿，我必须带她回文明世界，但我说没门，我要走了。

sentences.en: I told her she could go with me if she wanted, but she'd better hurry and get her stuff together.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她如果愿意可以跟我一起走，但她最好快点把东西收拾好。

sentences.en: Unable to navigate out of the sprawling, unfamiliar and dangerous forest alone,
sentences.zh: 由于无法独自一人走出这片广阔、陌生且危险的森林，

sentences.en: Candra opted to stay with Tom, hoping he would come to his senses.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉选择留在汤姆身边，希望他能恢复理智。

sentences.en: Tom covered Julio and Rusty's bodies with shrubbery to deter animals from scavenging their remains.
sentences.zh: 汤姆用灌木丛盖住了胡利奥和拉斯特的尸体，以防动物啃食他们的遗体。

sentences.en: Then, over the next three days, he trudged deeper and deeper into the forest with Candra in tow.
sentences.zh: 随后在接下来的三天里，他带着坎德拉在森林里越走越深。

sentences.en: They'd rest under the stars in a sleeping bag, and at a certain point, Tom tossed the rifle that had killed Julio into the surrounding brush, along with a bag of ammunition.
sentences.zh: 他们在星空下的睡袋里休息，走到某处时，汤姆将那支杀死胡利奥的步枪连同一个装有弹药的袋子一起扔进了周围的灌木丛中。

sentences.en: Sensing Tom had since calmed down, Candra worked to convince him to return to town and tell police what had happened.
sentences.zh: 感觉到汤姆此时已经冷静下来，坎德拉开始说服他返回镇上并把发生的事情告诉警察。

sentences.en: Her persistence paid off, and Tom finally agreed.
sentences.zh: 她的坚持收到了成效，汤姆最终同意了。

sentences.en: By then, the pair were well and truly loSt.
sentences.zh: 到那时，两人已经彻底迷失了方向。

sentences.en: It took a while for Tom to find his way back to a familiar trail, but once he did, he managed to get them both back to the campsite.
sentences.zh: 汤姆花了很长时间才找到一条熟悉的小路，但一旦找到，他设法带着两人回到了营地。

sentences.en: He then drove Candra straight to Oregon City to see James O'Leary, an attorney who had represented Tom in his previous criminal matters.
sentences.zh: 随后他开车直接带着坎德拉去俄勒冈市拜访詹姆斯·奥利里，这位律师曾代表汤姆处理过他过去的刑事案件。

sentences.en: This was a precautionary measure to ensure Tom wouldn't be tricked into facing any murder charges.
sentences.zh: 这是一项预防措施，以确保汤姆不会被诱骗去面对任何谋杀指控。

sentences.en: By the time they met with police, Tom and Candra were distraught, but cooperative.
sentences.zh: 与警方会面时，汤姆和坎德拉虽然心神不宁但非常配合。

sentences.en: They agreed to provide formal statements separately.
sentences.zh: 他们同意分别提供正式口供。

sentences.en: This gave detectives the opportunity to check for inconsistencies in their story and determine if anything was afoot.
sentences.zh: 这给侦探们提供了机会，以检查他们的说法是否存在前后矛盾并确定是否有猫腻。

sentences.en: The pair's account, even when told individually, was consistent and matching.
sentences.zh: 这两个人的陈述，即使单独叙述，也前后一致且完全吻合。

sentences.en: While obviously upset, Candra was lucid and rational.
sentences.zh: 虽然显然很难过，但坎德拉头脑清醒且理智。

sentences.en: She was adamant that the shooting was not Tom's fault.
sentences.zh: 她坚决认为这起枪击案不是汤姆的错。

sentences.en: She was also appreciative of Tom.
sentences.zh: 她也很感激汤姆。

sentences.en: Had he not helped her, she would still be lost in the immense forest, all alone.
sentences.zh: 如果不是他帮忙，她现在还独自一人迷失在这片茫茫森林中。

sentences.en: Later that night, Tom Brown escorted investigators into the Mount Hood National ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，汤姆·布朗带着调查人员进入了胡德山国家森林。

sentences.en: It was almost 8.30 when the group arrived at the location where Tom, Julio and Candra had set up camp.
sentences.zh: 当一行人到达汤姆、胡利奥和坎德拉扎营的地点时，将近8点30分。

sentences.en: Sweeping the area with high-powered torches, investigators spotted the trio's burnt-out cooking fire and the Torres' sedan.
sentences.zh: 调查人员用高强度手电筒扫视该地区，发现了三人烧毁的营火和托雷斯一家的轿车。

sentences.en: Two hundred yards away, beneath the fronds of St. Ferns, was the body of Julio Torres.
sentences.zh: 在二百码外、蕨类植物的叶片下，躺着胡利奥·托雷斯的尸体。

sentences.en: He lay face down, about thirty feet off the road and down an embankment.
sentences.zh: 他面朝下趴着，距离路边大约三十英尺，位于一道斜坡下方。

sentences.en: There was blood on the ground higher up by the edge of the road, pinpointing the location where the shooting had taken place.
sentences.zh: 路边高处的地面上有血迹，精确定位了枪击发生的地点。

sentences.en: Due to the hot summer weather, Julio's body was already in an advanced state of decomposition, but a gunshot wound was clearly visible in his head.
sentences.zh: 由于盛夏天气炎热，胡利奥的尸体已经高度腐烂，但头部清晰可见枪伤。

sentences.en: Rusty had sustained a similar wound.
sentences.zh: 拉斯特也受了类似的伤。

sentences.en: His body was found further along the trail, also haphazardly covered with leaves.
sentences.zh: 它的尸体在小路前方被找到，同样被杂乱地用树叶盖着。

sentences.en: Tom had since willingly surrendered the .22-calibre Savage rifle he had used to shoot Rusty.
sentences.zh: 汤姆此后自愿交出了他用来射杀拉斯特的那支.22口径萨维奇步枪。

sentences.en: The following morning, he led investigators through a heavily wooded area to where he had discarded the Winchester rifle that killed Julio.
sentences.zh: 第二天清晨，他带领调查人员穿过一片密林，来到他丢弃杀死胡利奥的温彻斯特步枪的地方。

sentences.en: They had to go on foot, trekking through thick vegetation as they followed the Colawash River upstream.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不步行，沿着科拉沃什河逆流而上，在茂密的植被中艰难跋涉。

sentences.en: They walked for hours through the forest, across the river, and then along another stream.
sentences.zh: 他们在森林中步行了数小时，穿过河流，然后沿着另一条溪流前进。

sentences.en: The forest had become a dense, disorientating maze, but there was one clue that indicated they were heading in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 森林已经变成了一个密不透风、令人晕头转向的迷宫，但有一个线索表明他们走对了方向。

sentences.en: Investigators noticed a set of Tom's footprints that had been previously crushed into the earth.
sentences.zh: 调查人员注意到了一组汤姆先前踩进泥土里的脚印。

sentences.en: A smaller pair, believed to be candoras, tailed them.
sentences.zh: 一双较小的脚印据信属于坎德拉，尾随其后。

sentences.en: As detailed in the book, Empty Promises, by true crime author Ian Rule, after ten hours of hiking, Tom eventually stopped, pointed, and remarked.
sentences.zh: 正如真实犯罪作家伊恩·鲁尔在书《空洞的承诺》中所详述的那样，经过十小时的徒步，汤姆终于停下脚步，指着前方说。

sentences.en: There it is.
sentences.zh: 就在那儿。

sentences.en: There's my rifle.
sentences.zh: 我的步枪在那儿。

sentences.en: They had arrived at the site where he and Kandra camped on their second night together in the wilderness.
sentences.zh: 他们到达了他和坎德拉在荒野中度过第二个夜晚时扎营的地点。

sentences.en: Although Tom said he'd thrown a plastic bag that contained about 11 bullets into the underbrush nearby, they were unable to find it.
sentences.zh: 尽管汤姆说他把一个装有大约11发子弹的塑料袋扔进了附近的灌木丛，但他们没能找到它。

sentences.en: Detectives did recover a sleeping bag that almost looked like it had been shredded due to being dragged through the rough terrain.
sentences.zh: 侦探们确实找回了一个睡袋，由于被拖过崎岖的地形，它看起来几乎被撕碎了。

sentences.en: Tom said he and Kandra had thrown it away once they found the trail home again.
sentences.zh: 汤姆说他和坎德拉一旦找到回家的路就把这东西扔了。

sentences.en: Over the coming days, Tom remained obliging and eager to assist with the investigation.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，汤姆一直很乐意效劳并渴望协助调查。

sentences.en: He willingly provided a second statement and underwent a polygraph test, which he passed.
sentences.zh: 他自愿提供了第二份口供并接受了测谎仪测试，结果顺利通过。

sentences.en: With everything aligning with Tom and Kandra's version of events, Julio Torres' death was ruled accidental.
sentences.zh: 由于一切都与汤姆和坎德拉的版本吻合，胡利奥·托雷斯的死被裁定为意外。

sentences.en: Lola Bates was deeply worried about her daughter, Kandra.
sentences.zh: 劳拉·贝茨深为女儿坎德拉感到担忧。

sentences.en: At just 16 years old, Kandra was too young to suddenly find herself a widow.
sentences.zh: 年仅16岁的坎德拉太年轻了，突然之间沦为了寡妇。

sentences.en: The weekend camping trip into the Mount Hood National Forest was supposed to be a celebration of Kandra and Julio's first wedding anniversary.
sentences.zh: 去胡德山国家森林的周末露营之旅本该是为了庆祝坎德拉和胡利奥结婚一周年。

sentences.en: Kandra had been a young bride, having married Julio, who was five years older than her, when she was just 15.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉是个年轻的新娘，她在15岁时嫁给了比她大五岁的胡利奥。

sentences.en: Kandra's family was religious, and her father had encouraged Kandra and Julio to marry before their relationship became too physical.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉的家庭很虔诚，她的父亲曾鼓励坎德拉和胡利奥在关系变得过分亲密之前结婚。

sentences.en: Wedding photos showed Kandra in a long-sleeved lace dress, her long, dark red hair parted down the middle and hanging over her shoulders.
sentences.zh: 结婚照显示，坎德拉穿着一件长袖蕾丝连衣裙，她那长长的深红色头发从中间分缝，垂在双肩上。

sentences.en: In one picture, she fed cake to a beaming Julio, who was tall and broad-shouldered with thick dark hair, matching sideburns and a moustache.
sentences.zh: 在其中一张照片中，她正在给笑容满面的胡利奥喂蛋糕，胡利奥身材高大、肩膀宽阔，留着浓密的黑发、相配的连鬓胡子和八字胡。

sentences.en: The Oregon-based couple lived in a small apartment in the small city of Kambi with Rusty, their rough collie dog, who had been Kandra's pet since childhood.
sentences.zh: 这对居住在俄勒冈州的夫妇住在坎比小城的一间小公寓里，陪伴他们的是拉斯特，一只苏格兰牧羊犬，也是坎德拉从小到大的宠物。

sentences.en: Following Julio and Rusty's sudden and violent deaths, Kandra stayed with her parents so they could look after her.
sentences.zh: 在胡里奥和拉斯特遭遇突发和暴力的死亡后，坎德拉一直和父母住在一起，以便他们照顾她。

sentences.en: Lola watched her daughter closely in those first few days.
sentences.zh: 在最初的几天里，罗拉密切注视着女儿。

sentences.en: She couldn't shake the feeling that something wasn't quite right.
sentences.zh: 她总有一种挥之不去的直觉，觉得哪里有些不对劲。

sentences.en: Kandra's voice when describing the shootings didn't sound like her usual self.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉在描述枪击事件时的声音听起来和平时不太一样。

sentences.en: As Lola told the television program Forensic Files, it was as though Kandra's words were coming out of a stereo, being replayed or something.
sentences.zh: 正如罗拉在电视节目《法医档案》中所说的那样，坎德拉的话听起来就像是从立体声里放出来的一样，像是在被重播或者别的什么。

sentences.en: Perhaps this was simply the way she was processing her grief, but it still gave Lola pause.
sentences.zh: 也许这只是她消化悲痛的方式，但仍然让罗拉感到迟疑。

sentences.en: It wasn't until Kandra returned to the apartment she'd shared with Julio that her demeanour changed.
sentences.zh: 直到坎德拉回到她和胡里奥合租的公寓，她的行为举止才发生了变化。

sentences.en: Her parents went with her, and as soon as Kandra stepped through the door, she broke down in sobs.
sentences.zh: 她的父母陪她一起去了，坎德拉刚一走进门，就失声痛哭起来。

sentences.en: Kandra suddenly began begging her parents.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉突然开始哀求她的父母。

sentences.en: Mama and Daddy, don't hate me.
sentences.zh: 妈妈，爸爸，不要恨我。

sentences.en: Don't hate me.
sentences.zh: 不要恨我。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本集赞助商的广告来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Ever since she'd returned home, Kandra Torres had struggled to comprehend her thoughts and feelings.
sentences.zh: 自从回到家后，坎德拉·托雷斯就一直在努力理清自己的思绪和情感。

sentences.en: It was as though her mind was a blur, with many details missing.
sentences.zh: 她的脑海里一片模糊，许多细节都记不清了。

sentences.en: She remembered the lead-up to that fateful weekend.
sentences.zh: 她还记得那个决定命运的周末之前发生的事。

sentences.en: She and Julio didn't have much money, but they still wanted to celebrate their first anniversary with a trip away somewhere.
sentences.zh: 她和胡里奥并没有多少钱，但他们仍然想来一次异地旅行来庆祝他们的第一个结婚纪念日。

sentences.en: The obvious answer was to go camping.
sentences.zh: 最显而易见的选择就是去露营。

sentences.en: Kandra suggested that they travel to the coast, where they had their honeymoon.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉建议他们去他们度蜜月时去过的那片海滨。

sentences.en: But Julio loved fishing and wanted to share the hobby with his wife, so he asked if they could instead head into the mountains.
sentences.zh: 但胡里奥热爱钓鱼，想和妻子分享这个爱好，于是他问他们是否可以改去山里。

sentences.en: Kandra agreed, telling herself they could always visit the beach another time.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉同意了，她心里想着海滩以后随时都可以去。

sentences.en: The night before they left for the Mount Hood National Forest, Kandra's sleep was disrupted by a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 就在他们出发前往胡德山国家森林的前一天晚上，坎德拉被一场噩梦惊醒了。

sentences.en: She woke terrified, but was unable to remember the exact details of her dream.
sentences.zh: 她醒来时惊恐万分，却记不清梦境的具体细节了。

sentences.en: All she knew was that it had something to do with their impending trip.
sentences.zh: 她只知道这与他们即将到来的旅行有关。

sentences.en: Kandra told a friend about her bad dream the next morning of Thursday July 22.
sentences.zh: 在7月22日星期四的第二天早上，坎德拉把她的噩梦讲给了一个朋友听。

sentences.en: They advised her to take a Bible with her for spiritual protection, and Kandra tucked one away in amongst her clothes and other belongings.
sentences.zh: 朋友建议她带上一本《圣经》以求心灵庇护，于是坎德拉把一本《圣经》塞进了衣服和其他随身物品中。

sentences.en: She also brought up her nightmare to Julio, thinking he would settle her nerves.
sentences.zh: 她还向胡里奥提到了自己的噩梦，以为这样能平复一下紧张的心情。

sentences.en: To Kandra's surprise, Julio admitted that he too felt inexplicably anxious about the trip.
sentences.zh: 令坎德拉惊讶的是，胡里奥承认他对这次旅行也有一种莫名的焦虑。

sentences.en: For peace of mind, they decided to invite one of Julio's friends to camp with them, but he wasn't at home when they arrived to extend their invitation.
sentences.zh: 为了求得心安，他们决定邀请胡里奥的一个朋友和他们一起露营，但当他们去发出邀请时，他不在家。

sentences.en: They left a hastily scribbled note for him to read upon his return.
sentences.zh: 他们匆忙留下一张字条，等他回来时好看。

sentences.en: We were by to ask you to go to the mountains with us.
sentences.zh: 我们来找你是想邀请你和我们一起去山里。

sentences.en: Sorry, you missed the fun.
sentences.zh: 真遗憾，你错过了好玩的。

sentences.en: By the time Julio and Kandra arrived in the mountains, the weather was warm and the sky was blue.
sentences.zh: 当胡里奥和坎德拉到达山区时，天气晴暖，天空湛蓝。

sentences.en: Amidst the bright light and picturesque setting, the couple's fears melted away.
sentences.zh: 在明媚的阳光和风景如画的环境中，这对夫妇的恐惧烟消云散了。

sentences.en: A wrong turn led them deeper into the forest on a road they'd never been down before.
sentences.zh: 一个错误的拐弯把他们带向森林更深处，那是一条他们从未走过的小路。

sentences.en: There was something about the road that gave Julio the creeps.
sentences.zh: 这条路有点诡异，让胡里奥感到毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: Eventually, they realised their mistake and turned around.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们意识到走错了路，于是调转了车头。

sentences.en: That night, the pair slept in their car.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，两人睡在车里。

sentences.en: Julio spent the next day fishing, but he failed to catch anything.
sentences.zh: 接下来的整整一天胡里奥都在钓鱼，但他什么也没钓到。

sentences.en: The couple moved on to a different location to see if Julio would have better luck there.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇换到了另一个地方，看看胡里奥在那里能不能走运。

sentences.en: They followed the Clackamas River downstream, stopping periodically to cast a line.
sentences.zh: 他们顺着克拉克马斯河下游前行，并不时停下来抛竿。

sentences.en: During one stop, they spoke to another fisherman who'd also been struggling.
sentences.zh: 在其中一次停留时，他们遇到了另一个同样收获惨淡的渔夫。

sentences.en: He'd heard that a truck full of fish had recently been moved to the Colawash River, a 12-mile tributary of the Clackamas River,
sentences.zh: 他听说不久前有一卡车鱼被放到了科拉瓦什河，那是克拉克马斯河一条长达12英里的支流，

sentences.en: and suggested that the couple check in with the park rangers to see if that was true.
sentences.zh: 并建议这对夫妇去向公园管理员核实一下这是不是真的。

sentences.en: Julio and Kandra weren't sure what to do.
sentences.zh: 胡里奥和坎德拉不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: They'd filled up their car with gas when they left, but now its tank was getting very low.
sentences.zh: 他们出发时把车加满了油，但现在油箱已经快见底了。

sentences.en: They only had $20 left and needed to hang on to it in case of an emergency.
sentences.zh: 他们身上只剩下20美元了，必须留着以防万一。

sentences.en: After talking their predicament over, the couple decided to try one last location before giving up and returning home.
sentences.zh: 在商量了他们的困境后，这对夫妇决定在放弃并回家之前再去最后一个地方试试。

sentences.en: The sun was setting when they reached the North Fork Dam.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达北福克大坝时，太阳正在下山。

sentences.en: There, Julio spotted a lone man observing the nearby fish ladder.
sentences.zh: 在那里，胡里奥发现了一个人在观察附近的鱼梯。

sentences.en: Meeting Tom Brown was crystal clear in Kandra's memory.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉对遇到汤姆·布朗的记忆依然清晰无比。

sentences.en: She remembered how he lit up and flashed her a wide smile when she approached.
sentences.zh: 她记得当她走近时，他如何双眼放光，冲她咧嘴大笑。

sentences.en: It was sleazy, as if he were undressing her with his eyes.
sentences.zh: 那笑容很猥琐，就像在用眼神把她剥光衣服一样。

sentences.en: She never shook the uneasy feeling he gave her.
sentences.zh: 她始终无法摆脱他带给她的那种不安感。

sentences.en: That night, around the campfire, Tom retrieved a milk carton from his truck and showed it to Julio and Kandra.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，在营火旁，汤姆从他的卡车里拿出一个牛奶纸盒，给胡里奥和坎德拉看。

sentences.en: It contained a dead bird.
sentences.zh: 里面装着一只死鸟。

sentences.en: I picked it off on the way here, Tom bragged.
sentences.zh: “我在来这里的路上顺手打的，”汤姆吹嘘道。

sentences.en: Kandra was unimpressed.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉对此无感。

sentences.en: She didn't believe in shooting animals for sport.
sentences.zh: 她不赞成为了消遣而射杀动物。

sentences.en: Not unless you have to for food, she told Tom.
sentences.zh: “除非为了食物不得已而为之，”她对汤姆说。

sentences.en: He told her not to worry and said he planned to eat the bird.
sentences.zh: 他让她不用担心，并说他打算把这只鸟吃掉。

sentences.en: On the walk the trio took later that night, Tom unsettled Kandra further when he raised his rifle at several bear cubs playing in the distance.
sentences.zh: 在三人当天晚些时候散步时，汤姆将步枪举向远处玩耍的几只小熊，这让坎德拉感到更加不安。

sentences.en: She turned away in disapproval, fearful his actions would attract the bear's mother and put them in danger.
sentences.zh: 她不赞同地转过头去，担心他的行为会引来母熊并使他们陷入危险。

sentences.en: Tom flashed Kandra yet another unnerving smile and lowered his weapon.
sentences.zh: 汤姆向坎德拉露出了另一个令人不安的微笑，然后放下了武器。

sentences.en: Kandra struggled to sleep that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上坎德拉辗转难眠。

sentences.en: She didn't like Tom and the way he seemed to enjoy killing for its own sake.
sentences.zh: 她不喜欢汤姆，也不喜欢他那种似乎为了杀戮而杀戮的乐趣。

sentences.en: She expressed her concerns to Julio, who regarded Tom as eccentric but harmless.
sentences.zh: 她向胡里奥表达了她的担忧，而胡里奥认为汤姆只是有点古怪，并没有恶意。

sentences.en: Although, he did tell Kandra to button up her blouse to hide her bikini top.
sentences.zh: 不过，他确实告诉坎德拉把衬衫扣子扣好，把比基尼上衣遮住。

sentences.en: Kandra's anxieties only increased the following day.
sentences.zh: 第二天，坎德拉的焦虑感有增无减。

sentences.en: She noticed how Tom loosely carried his rifle while keeping its barrel pointed at Julio.
sentences.zh: 她注意到汤姆漫不经心地扛着步枪，同时枪口始终指着胡里奥。

sentences.en: Then he made a disturbing joke about her beloved dog.
sentences.zh: 接着，他开了一个关于她心爱的狗狗的恶劣玩笑。

sentences.en: There are only two things wrong with Rusty, Tom said as he padded the collie.
sentences.zh: “拉斯特只有两个毛病，”汤姆一边拍着牧羊犬一边说。

sentences.en: He's alive and walking.
sentences.zh: “一是它活着，二是它会走路。”

sentences.en: Despite remembering all of this lead up to Julio's death,
sentences.zh: 尽管记得胡里奥死前发生的所有这些前前后后的事，

sentences.en: Kandra realised that she couldn't actually recall the exact moment he was killed.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉却意识到，她实际上记不清他遇害时的确切瞬间了。

sentences.en: She genuinely believed she had witnessed the shooting, as she'd told detectives, but she couldn't picture it in her mind.
sentences.zh: 她曾真诚地以为自己目睹了枪击过程，正如她对侦探们所说的那样，但她在脑海里怎么也拼凑不出画面。

sentences.en: All that Kandra could remember was the sound of a loud rifle blast, then the side of Julio's body covered in blood.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉能记住的只有一声巨大的步枪巨响，然后胡里奥的半边身子就沾满了鲜血。

sentences.en: She tried to recall more, but her mind was blank.
sentences.zh: 她试图回忆更多，但脑子里一片空白。

sentences.en: Over the course of a few days, another picture arose from Kandra's subconscious.
sentences.zh: 在几天的时间里，另一个画面从坎德拉的潜意识中浮现出来。

sentences.en: She could clearly see Tom Brown's face, plastered with a wide smile.
sentences.zh: 她能清晰地看到汤姆·布朗的脸，挂着一个大大的微笑。

sentences.en: It wasn't until Kandra returned to the apartment she and Julio shared that something was unlocked within her.
sentences.zh: 直到坎德拉回到她和胡里奥合租的公寓，她内心的某些东西才被解开。

sentences.en: After begging her parents not to hate her and being reassured that they never could,
sentences.zh: 在恳求父母不要恨她并得到他们绝不会恨她的保证后，

sentences.en: Kandra made a confession.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉吐露了实情。

sentences.en: She didn't know if Julio's death was an accident or not, because she hadn't actually seen it for herself.
sentences.zh: 她不知道胡里奥的死是不是一场意外，因为她实际上并没有亲眼目睹。

sentences.en: In shock, her mother Lola replied,
sentences.zh: 震惊之中的母亲罗拉回答说：

sentences.en: My God, Kandra, don't you realise that man murdered your husband?
sentences.zh: “天哪，坎德拉，难道你没意识到那个男人谋杀了你丈夫吗？”

sentences.en: Six days after Kandra Torres and Tom Brown had emerged from the wilderness,
sentences.zh: 在坎德拉·托雷斯和汤姆·布朗从荒野中走出来的六天后，

sentences.en: Kandra paid another visit to the county sheriff's office.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉再次拜访了县警长办公室。

sentences.en: This time she was accompanied by her parents.
sentences.zh: 这一次陪同她的是她的父母。

sentences.en: I want to tell you what really happened, Kandra said.
sentences.zh: “我想告诉你们真正发生了什么，”坎德拉说。

sentences.en: It wasn't an accident.
sentences.zh: “那不是意外。”

sentences.en: On the morning of Saturday July 24,
sentences.zh: 在7月24日星期六的早晨，

sentences.en: Kandra gave Julio a quick kiss before he left the campsite to go hunting with Tom Brown.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉在胡里奥离开营地与汤姆·布朗去打猎之前飞快地吻了他一下。

sentences.en: Kandra stayed put with Rusty, who was resting in the sun.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉留在原地陪着正在晒太阳休息的拉斯特。

sentences.en: A sense of foreboding washed over her.
sentences.zh: 一种不祥的预感涌上她的心头。

sentences.en: The air was extremely still and quiet.
sentences.zh: 空气异常寂静。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Kandra was startled by the unmistakable sound of a gunshot ringing through the foreSt.
sentences.zh: 突然，一声清晰的枪声在森林中回荡，把坎德拉吓了一跳。

sentences.en: For a split second, Kandra was overcome with the impulse to run into the woods with Rusty.
sentences.zh: 在极短的一瞬间，坎德拉脑海里涌起一股冲动，想带着拉斯特跑进树林里。

sentences.en: But then she told herself to stop being silly.
sentences.zh: 但随后她告诫自己别胡思乱想了。

sentences.en: She had no way to navigate the forest and would only end up getting lost, which would worry Julio.
sentences.zh: 她根本不会在森林里辨别方向，最终只会迷路，这会让胡里奥担心的。

sentences.en: There was no need to run.
sentences.zh: 根本没有必要逃跑。

sentences.en: Julio and Tom must have found a deer.
sentences.zh: 胡里奥和汤姆一定是找到鹿了。

sentences.en: Kandra remained where she was and waited for their return.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉留在原地等待他们回来。

sentences.en: A little while later, she saw Tom walking towards the campsite.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，她看到汤姆朝营地走来。

sentences.en: There was no sign of Julio.
sentences.zh: 不见胡里奥的踪影。

sentences.en: As reported in the book Empty Promises, Tom called out to Kandra,
sentences.zh: 正如《空洞的承诺》一书中所述，汤姆向坎德拉大喊：

sentences.en: We got us a deer.
sentences.zh: “我们打到一头鹿！”

sentences.en: He added that Julio was still in the clearing, cleaning the carcass.
sentences.zh: 他补充说胡里奥还在林间空地清理猎物。

sentences.en: Kandra was immediately suspicious.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉立刻起了疑心。

sentences.en: It made no sense to her that Julio would remain behind with the deer, as he wasn't a hunter and wouldn't know how to gut an animal.
sentences.zh: 在她看来，胡里奥根本不可能留在原地处理鹿，因为他不是猎人，也不知道该怎么给动物开膛破肚。

sentences.en: Gripped with a fear that had been bubbling since she first met Tom Brown, Kandra got up and ran towards the clearing.
sentences.zh: 自第一次见到汤姆·布朗以来就一直在心底翻涌的恐惧攫住了她，坎德拉起身朝林间空地跑去。

sentences.en: Another gunshot rang out.
sentences.zh: 又一声枪声响起。

sentences.en: Kandra stopped and turned around.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉停下脚步转过身来。

sentences.en: Rusty, who had been beside her a moment ago, had fallen on the ground.
sentences.zh: 刚才还待在她身边的拉斯特已经倒在了地上。

sentences.en: His legs jerked and his head was stained with blood.
sentences.zh: 它的四肢抽搐着，脑袋上满是血迹。

sentences.en: Tom stood a little distance behind, holding a smouldering rifle.
sentences.zh: 汤姆站在不远处，手里拿着一支还冒着烟的步枪。

sentences.en: He then pointed it at Kandra.
sentences.zh: 接着他把枪指向了坎德拉。

sentences.en: You shot my dog, she cried.
sentences.zh: “你打死了我的狗！”她大喊道。

sentences.en: A broad grin appeared on Tom's face as he replied.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的脸上露出一个灿烂的笑容，回答说：

sentences.en: Yeah, I know.
sentences.zh: “对，我知道。”

sentences.en: I shot your husband, too.
sentences.zh: “我也把你丈夫给崩了。”

sentences.en: At that moment, Kandra Torres was certain she was going to die.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，坎德拉·托雷斯确信自己死定了。

sentences.en: Barely able to comprehend the enormity of the situation she was in,
sentences.zh: 坎德拉几乎无法承受自己所处困境的严重性，

sentences.en: Kandra begged Tom not to hurt her.
sentences.zh: 她哀求汤姆不要伤害她。

sentences.en: Although he had been aiming his rifle at her, Tom didn't fire it.
sentences.zh: 尽管汤姆一直用步枪指着她，但他并没有开枪。

sentences.en: Instead, he forced Kandra to drag Rusty's corpse off the trail and cover it with foliage.
sentences.zh: 相反，他强迫坎德拉把拉斯特的尸体拖离小路并用树叶盖上。

sentences.en: As she moved Rusty's body, Kandra noticed that his paws were still twitching.
sentences.zh: 在挪动拉斯特的尸体时，坎德拉注意到它的爪子还在抽搐。

sentences.en: Thinking he might be merely injured and able to be saved,
sentences.zh: 以为它可能只是受伤了还有救，

sentences.en: Kandra asked Tom to let her look after him.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉请求汤姆让她照顾它。

sentences.en: Tom refused.
sentences.zh: 汤姆拒绝了。

sentences.en: Those are his reflexes, he told Kandra.
sentences.zh: “那是它的神经反射，”他对坎德拉说。

sentences.en: I never have to shoot anything more than once.
sentences.zh: “我从不需要对任何东西开第二枪。”

sentences.en: I don't like to see anything suffer.
sentences.zh: “我可不喜欢看任何东西受苦。”

sentences.en: Once Kandra covered Rusty's body, Tom bound her wrists and took her to the clearing where he had shot Julio.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉盖好拉斯特的尸体后，汤姆绑起她的手腕，把她带到了他枪杀胡里奥的那片林间空地。

sentences.en: He warned her not to look at Julio's body as it would distress her and left her standing nearby while he retrieved a watch that Julio had been wearing.
sentences.zh: 他警告她不准看胡里奥的尸体，因为那会让她难过，并把她留在附近，自己则去取胡里奥戴过的一块手表。

sentences.en: When Tom returned, he said to Kandra,
sentences.zh: 汤姆回来后，对坎德拉说：

sentences.en: You're not allowed to cry.
sentences.zh: “不准哭。”

sentences.en: I'm going to tell you a story.
sentences.zh: “我要给你讲个故事。”

sentences.en: His name wasn't really Tom, he told her.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，他的名字其实不叫汤姆。

sentences.en: It was Kent.
sentences.zh: 而是肯特。

sentences.en: And he wasn't a logger.
sentences.zh: 而且他也不是伐木工。

sentences.en: He was a hitman for an organised crime group.
sentences.zh: 他是一个有组织犯罪集团的杀手。

sentences.en: He'd murdered five or six people and was wanted across several different states.
sentences.zh: 他谋杀过五六个人，在好几个不同的州都被通缉。

sentences.en: But now, Tom was on the run from the mobsters he'd worked for because he had killed, quote,
sentences.zh: 但现在，汤姆正在躲避他曾为其效力的黑帮分子的追杀，因为他用他的话说，

sentences.en: One man too many.
sentences.zh: “多杀了一个人”。

sentences.en: The reason he shot Julio was because he wanted a female companion and Kandra looked strong enough to live off the land with him.
sentences.zh: 他枪杀胡里奥的原因是他想要一个女性伴侣，而坎德拉看起来足够强壮，可以和他一起在野外生存。

sentences.en: After he finished explaining all of this, he said,
sentences.zh: 当他解释完这一切后，他说：

sentences.en: Now you can cry.
sentences.zh: “现在你可以哭了。”

sentences.en: Kandra wept uncontrollably before telling Tom that she had no idea how to live off the land.
sentences.zh: 坎andra无法控制地痛哭起来，随后对汤姆说她根本不知道怎么在野外求生。

sentences.en: Tom just smiled and tried to hug her instead.
sentences.zh: 汤姆只是笑了笑，试图转而拥抱她。

sentences.en: After a little while, Tom made Kandra pack up some belongings so they could begin hiking through the foreSt.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，汤姆让坎andra收拾了一些随身物品，这样他们就可以开始在森林里徒步前行。

sentences.en: Claiming that the criminals he'd worked for were after them, he ordered her to change into a pair of army pants as camouflage.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己曾为其效力的罪犯正在追捕他们，并命令她换上一条军裤作为伪装。

sentences.en: Tom said that if the mobsters managed to find them, Kandra should run in the opposite direction as him for survival.
sentences.zh: 汤姆说，如果暴徒设法找到他们，坎andra为了活命应该朝与他相反的方向逃跑。

sentences.en: The people pursuing him wouldn't harm her if they separated.
sentences.zh: 如果他们分开，追捕他的人就不会伤害她。

sentences.en: They hiked for four hours.
sentences.zh: 他们徒步走了四个小时。

sentences.en: Tom insisted that Kandra only step on rocks and stones to avoid leading footprints.
sentences.zh: 汤姆坚持要坎andra只踩在岩石和石头上，以免留下脚印。

sentences.en: If an aircraft flew overhead, she had to duck.
sentences.zh: 如果有飞机从头顶飞过，她必须蹲下。

sentences.en: As they walked, Tom occasionally discarded items by tossing them into the brush.
sentences.zh: 在他们行走时，汤姆偶尔会把东西扔进灌木丛中来丢弃它们。

sentences.en: Kandra suspected he was trying to throw people off their path.
sentences.zh: 坎andra怀疑他是想把人们的视线从他们的行踪上引开。

sentences.en: They eventually stopped by the river.
sentences.zh: 他们最终在河边停了下来。

sentences.en: While Kandra went into the water to wash up, Tom lay on a sleeping bag.
sentences.zh: 当坎andra下水清洗时，汤姆躺在睡袋上。

sentences.en: Then he demanded she join him and threatened her with a knife before raping her as she cried.
sentences.zh: 接着他要求她加入自己，并用刀威胁她，随后在她哭泣时强暴了她。

sentences.en: After hiking throughout the rest of the day, they set up camp.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的整天徒步旅行后，他们扎营了。

sentences.en: Tom constantly told Kandra disturbing things.
sentences.zh: 汤姆不断地对坎andra说一些令人不安的话。

sentences.en: He said he could have killed Julio with his bare hands if he wanted, but he chose to shoot him instead because it was quick and painless.
sentences.zh: 他说如果他愿意，本可以用双手杀死胡利奥，但他选择开枪打死他，因为那样又快又没有痛苦。

sentences.en: He also revealed that he'd initially planned to murder Julio the previous evening, but decided to let the couple have one final night together out of kindness.
sentences.zh: 他还透露，他最初计划在前一天晚上谋杀胡利奥，但出于善意，决定让这对夫妇共度最后一个夜晚。

sentences.en: Kandra asked why Kandra asked why he hadn't just left Julio tied up somewhere before abducting her.
sentences.zh: 坎andra问坎andra为什么在绑架她之前不把胡利奥绑在某个地方。

sentences.en: That would have been mean, Tom replied.
sentences.zh: 汤姆回答说，那太不近人情了。

sentences.en: Likewise, he said he had killed Rusty as an act of mercy because the dog wouldn't have been able to survive their journey.
sentences.zh: 同样，他说他杀死拉斯蒂是出于仁慈，因为这只狗无法在他们的旅程中幸存。

sentences.en: Tom told Kandra stories about his violent past and the many murders he had committed.
sentences.zh: 汤姆向坎andra讲述了他暴力的过去以及他犯下的许多谋杀案。

sentences.en: He was a big fan of Adolf Hitler and said he hated his family.
sentences.zh: 他是阿道夫·希特勒的超级粉丝，并说他恨自己的家人。

sentences.en: When he wasn't ranting, Tom would rape Kandra.
sentences.zh: 当不长篇大论时，汤姆就会强暴坎andra。

sentences.en: She was struck by how nasty looking his eyes were.
sentences.zh: 她对他的眼睛看起来多么令人讨厌感到震惊。

sentences.en: Kandra was led further into the woods.
sentences.zh: 坎andra被带得更深入树林。

sentences.en: Whenever Tom paused to take a break, Kandra pulled out the Bible her friend had encouraged her to pack and read aloud from it.
sentences.zh: 每当汤姆停下来休息时，坎andra就会掏出她朋友鼓励她打包的圣经并大声朗读。

sentences.en: Taking note of her faith, Tom told Kandra that he too had been a Christian once, but he knew that God had given up on him.
sentences.zh: 注意到她的信仰，汤姆告诉坎andra他曾经也是个基督徒，但他知道上帝已经放弃了他。

sentences.en: Kandra replied that God didn't give up on anybody.
sentences.zh: 坎andra回答说上帝不会放弃任何人。

sentences.en: As time went on, the pair continued to talk.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，两人继续交谈。

sentences.en: They had long conversations about a wide range of topics, from films and books to deeper subjects such as the nature of humanity.
sentences.zh: 他们就广泛的话题进行了长时间的对话，从电影和书籍到诸如人性本质等更深层次的主题。

sentences.en: At one point, Tom told Kandra how the human mind held multiple doors that one could open and close at will.
sentences.zh: 有一次，汤姆告诉坎andra人类的脑海里有多少扇可以随意开合的门。

sentences.en: When he needed to kill a person, he simply opened a door in his brain that allowed that.
sentences.zh: 当他需要杀人时，他只需打开大脑中允许这样做的门。

sentences.en: Kandra found herself gradually forgetting about the terrible things Tom had done.
sentences.zh: 坎andra发现自己逐渐忘记了汤姆做过的可怕事情。

sentences.en: But his mood could change in an instant.
sentences.zh: 但他的情绪可能会在瞬间改变。

sentences.en: He would go from being caring and considerate to angry without warning.
sentences.zh: 他会毫无预兆地从关怀体贴变得愤怒。

sentences.en: On Monday, July 26, two days after the murder of Julio, Tom woke up with a bad cough and told Kandra that he thought he had pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 7月26日星期一，即胡利奥被谋杀两天后，汤姆醒来时咳嗽得很厉害，并告诉坎andra他觉得自己得了肺炎。

sentences.en: He asked her for some paper so he could write letters to friends, explaining that he would probably be dead soon.
sentences.zh: 他向她要了一些纸以便给朋友写信，并解释说他可能很快就会死。

sentences.en: At the thought of being left lost in the forest all alone, Kandra began to cry.
sentences.zh: 一想到自己会被孤零零地留在森林里迷失方向，坎andra便哭了起来。

sentences.en: And for the first time, so did Tom.
sentences.zh: 这是第一次，汤姆也哭了。

sentences.en: Then he told Kandra something.
sentences.zh: 然后他对坎andra说了一件事。

sentences.en: He hadn't actually meant to kill Julio, but he was worried no one would believe him.
sentences.zh: 他其实并不是故意要杀胡利奥，但他担心没人会相信他。

sentences.en: As described by Kandra in the Forensic Files episode, Head Games, Tom said,
sentences.zh: 正如坎andra在《法医档案》的一集《头脑游戏》中所描述的那样，汤姆说：

sentences.en: I didn't kill your husband on purpose.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意杀你丈夫的。

sentences.en: It was an accident.
sentences.zh: 那是个意外。

sentences.en: The reason that I brought you up here is because I'm afraid to go back to prison.
sentences.zh: 我把你带到这里的原因是因为我害怕回到监狱。

sentences.en: Kandra asked Tom if he was sure it was an accident.
sentences.zh: 坎andra问汤姆他是否确信那是一场意外。

sentences.en: He told her over and over that he was.
sentences.zh: 他一遍又一遍地告诉她他是。

sentences.en: Slowly, Kandra began to believe him.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，坎andra开始相信他了。

sentences.en: Armed with this new information, she made a promise.
sentences.zh: 有了这些新信息的武装，她做出承诺。

sentences.en: If you're sure, I'll go to the police with you and tell them I saw it, Kandra said.
sentences.zh: 坎andra说，如果你确定，我会和你一起去警察局，告诉他们我看到了。

sentences.en: Her words made Tom smile.
sentences.zh: 她的话让汤姆笑了。

sentences.en: Tom Brown agreed to take Kandra Torres back to the campsite where Julio and Rusty's bodies still lay.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·布朗同意带坎andra·托雷斯回到胡利奥和拉斯蒂尸体依然躺着的营地。

sentences.en: Then he would head back into the forest while Kandra could make her way back home.
sentences.zh: 然后他将独自返回森林，而坎andra则可以自行踏上回家的路。

sentences.en: Through repeated conversations, Kandra managed to convince Tom to join her in reporting the accident to authorities.
sentences.zh: 通过反复交谈，坎andra成功说服汤姆与她一起向当局报告这起意外。

sentences.en: The thought of leaving an ill man alone in the woods made her uneasy.
sentences.zh: 一想到把一个生病的男人独自留在树林里，她就感到不安。

sentences.en: When she promised to vouch for him with law enforcement, he agreed to join her.
sentences.zh: 当她承诺在执法部门面前为他作证时，他同意加入她。

sentences.en: They made it back to the area where they'd left their vehicles and got into Tom's truck.
sentences.zh: 他们回到了他们留下车辆的地区，并上了汤姆的卡车。

sentences.en: By the time they arrived at his lawyer's office the following morning,
sentences.zh: 当第二天早上他们到达他的律师办公室时，

sentences.en: Kandra had heard Tom describe how the rifle had misfired so many times that she truly believed she had seen it with her own eyes.
sentences.zh: 坎andra已经听汤姆描述了步枪走火了多少次，以至于她真的相信那是她亲眼目睹的。

sentences.en: Tom also insisted that he only shot Rusty in self-defence after the dog attacked him.
sentences.zh: 汤姆还坚称他在那只狗攻击他之后开枪射击拉斯蒂纯属正当防卫。

sentences.en: Kandra was convinced of this, too.
sentences.zh: 坎andra对此也深信不疑。

sentences.en: Detectives were stunned as they listened to Kandra relate this entirely new version of events.
sentences.zh: 侦探们在听坎andra讲述这套全新版本的事件经过时惊呆了。

sentences.en: They had believed the story that she and Tom Brown had originally told them and considered the case nothing more than an unfortunate accident.
sentences.zh: 他们一直相信她和汤姆·布朗最初对他们说的话，并认为这个案件不过是一起不幸的意外。

sentences.en: After hearing Kandra's amended account, they asked her to sit a polygraph teSt.
sentences.zh: 在听取了坎andra修改后的陈述后，他们要求她接受测谎测试。

sentences.en: Tom had already taken one after being interviewed twice and he had passed with no problems at all.
sentences.zh: 汤姆在被面谈两次后已经接受过一次测试，并且毫无问题地通过了。

sentences.en: Kandra agreed to their requeSt.
sentences.zh: 坎andra同意了他们的请求。

sentences.en: But, to her dismay, she failed the exam.
sentences.zh: 但是，令她沮丧的是，她考试没通过。

sentences.en: Despite this, investigators were intrigued by Kandra's new story.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，调查人员还是对坎andra的新故事很感兴趣。

sentences.en: The truth was that Tom, whose full name was Thomas Leslie Brown, had an extensive criminal history that included a number of violent crimes.
sentences.zh: 事实是，全名为托马斯·莱斯利·布朗的汤姆有着广泛的犯罪记录，其中包含许多暴力犯罪。

sentences.en: At the age of 16, he acquired a rifle and ammunition from a friend, then went out looking for people to rob.
sentences.zh: 在16岁时，他从一个朋友那里弄到了一支步枪和弹药，然后出去寻找抢劫目标。

sentences.en: He and another teenager drove towards the city of Canby and spotted a woman also driving on the same road.
sentences.zh: 他和另一个少年开车朝坎比市开去，发现一个女人也在同一条路上开车。

sentences.en: They ran her off the bitumen, then raced up to her car while wielding the gun and demanding money.
sentences.zh: 他们把她的车逼出柏油路面，然后挥舞着枪冲到她的车旁索要钱财。

sentences.en: The woman locked her vehicle's doors, so Brown fired the rifle twice.
sentences.zh: 那个女人锁上了她汽车的车门，于是布朗用步枪开了两枪。

sentences.en: Believing he'd hit the woman, he and his friends ran into a nearby foreSt.
sentences.zh: 以为自己击中了那个女人，他和朋友们跑进了一片附近的森林。

sentences.en: When they emerged a little while later, the woman's car was still parked by the side of the road, but there was no sign of her.
sentences.zh: 当他们不久后出来时，那个女人的车仍然停在路边，但不见她的踪影。

sentences.en: She had fled unscathed from the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 她毫发无损地从车里逃走了。

sentences.en: Tom and his friend got back in their car and sped away in the hopes of finding another victim.
sentences.zh: 汤姆和他的朋友重新上车，希望找到另一个受害者而飞驰而去。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a police car appeared in front of them, its lights flashing.
sentences.zh: 突然，一辆警车出现在他们面前，车灯闪烁着。

sentences.en: Realising it was coming for them, the two teenagers veered towards a turn-off and hit a truck.
sentences.zh: 意识到它是冲着他们来的，两个少年向一个岔路口急转弯并撞上了一辆卡车。

sentences.en: Their car flipped over.
sentences.zh: 他们的车翻了。

sentences.en: Tom fired out a window at the pursuing police officer, but missed.
sentences.zh: 汤姆隔着窗户向追赶的警官开枪，但没打中。

sentences.en: He crawled from the car and fled on foot.
sentences.zh: 他从车里爬出来，徒步逃跑。

sentences.en: Spotting a male passer-by, he went up to him and demanded his car keys.
sentences.zh: 发现一个男性路人，他走过去向他索要车钥匙。

sentences.en: The man said he had none, so Tom tried his luck at a house instead.
sentences.zh: 那个人说他没有，于是汤姆转而在一栋房子里碰碰运气。

sentences.en: A teenage girl answered the door, and when Tom threatened her, she ran across the street to a neighbour's property.
sentences.zh: 一个十几岁的女孩开了门，当汤姆威胁她时，她穿过街道跑到邻居的物业上。

sentences.en: Noticing the neighbour's pickup truck parked outside, Tom decided to steal it.
sentences.zh: 注意到邻居停在外面的皮卡车，汤姆决定偷走它。

sentences.en: He aimed his rifle at a young man standing in the window of the house and fired.
sentences.zh: 他用步枪瞄准了站在房子窗户里的年轻男子并开枪。

sentences.en: This time, his shot hit its mark.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他的子弹击中了目标。

sentences.en: The young man was wounded in the stomach.
sentences.zh: 那名年轻男子腹部受伤。

sentences.en: Tom got into the pickup truck, but immediately discovered there wasn't enough room in its cab for him to aim his weapon.
sentences.zh: 汤姆上了皮卡车，但立即发现驾驶室内没有足够的空间让他瞄准武器。

sentences.en: He hopped out again, just as sheriff's deputies arrived on the scene.
sentences.zh: 就在治安官副警长赶到现场时，他又跳了出去。

sentences.en: When officers later interviewed Tom and asked if he was responsible for shooting the young man,
sentences.zh: 当警官后来面谈汤姆并询问他是否对枪击这名年轻男子负有责任时，

sentences.en: Tom replied,
sentences.zh: 汤姆回答说，

sentences.en: Yeah, I wanted his car, and I was willing to kill to get it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想要他的车，为了得到它我甘愿杀人。

sentences.en: Luckily, his victim survived.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，他的受害者活了下来。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案室很快就会回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本集赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本集的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持档案室继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Tom Brown was sent to a reform school, but picked up his criminal career again upon release.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·布朗被送进了一所少年犯管教所，但在获释后重操旧业。

sentences.en: For a while, he mostly engaged in petty crimes, before developing an interest in a woman who had two young children.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，他主要从事轻微犯罪，之后对一个带着两个年幼孩子的女人产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: After a short period, she ended their relationship.
sentences.zh: 过了一小段时间后，她结束了他们的关系。

sentences.en: Furious at this, Tom abducted the woman and her children, then took them up to the mountains.
sentences.zh: 对此大为光火，汤姆绑架了这个女人和她的孩子们，然后把他们带到了山上。

sentences.en: He held them hostage overnight, before releasing them.
sentences.zh: 他把他们当人质扣押了一夜，然后释放了他们。

sentences.en: The woman declined to press charges out of fear that Tom would come after her.
sentences.zh: 由于害怕汤姆会来找她麻烦，该女子拒绝提出指控。

sentences.en: He openly spoke of the incident with police, stating,
sentences.zh: 他公开谈论了这起事件，并声称：

sentences.en: I was going to have her one way or another.
sentences.zh: 不管用什么方法我都要得到她。

sentences.en: I would have burned down her house, used a gun.
sentences.zh: 我会烧掉她的房子，用枪。

sentences.en: Whatever it took, so no one else would have her either.
sentences.zh: 无论付出什么代价，这样别人也就别想得到她。

sentences.en: After this, Tom relocated to the mid-western state of Nebraska and started working on a farm.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，汤姆搬到了中西部的美利坚州内布拉斯加州，并在一个农场工作。

sentences.en: His employer lent Tom his red GMC pickup truck.
sentences.zh: 他的雇主把一辆红色的GMC皮卡车借给了汤姆。

sentences.en: One day, Tom told his boss he planned to drive the truck into town.
sentences.zh: 有一天，汤姆告诉他的老板他打算把这辆卡车开进城里。

sentences.en: He had two of his employer's rifles with him at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时他随身带着雇主的两支步枪。

sentences.en: An entire day went by with no sign of Tom or the truck.
sentences.zh: 整整一天过去了，不见汤姆或卡车的踪影。

sentences.en: When Tom's employer realised he'd been robbed, he filed a stolen vehicle report with the police.
sentences.zh: 当汤姆的雇主意识到自己被抢劫时，他向警方报案称车辆被盗。

sentences.en: There was a warrant out for Tom's arrest in Nebraska, but law enforcement there never caught sight of him again.
sentences.zh: 内布拉斯加州对汤姆发出了通缉令，但那里的执法人员再也没有见过他。

sentences.en: It turned out that he had driven the stolen pickup all the way back to Oregon.
sentences.zh: 原来他把偷来的皮卡一直开回了俄勒冈州。

sentences.en: Tom's history of violence made investigators inclined to believe Candra Torres' second account of events, despite her failing her polygraph teSt.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的暴力历史使调查人员倾向于相信坎andra·托雷斯的第二份事件陈述，尽管她的测谎测试没有通过。

sentences.en: Although polygraphs are used in some jurisdictions as an interrogative tool and are sometimes referred to as lie detectors, they cannot detect lies.
sentences.zh: 尽管测谎仪在某些司法管辖区被用作讯问工具，有时也被称为测谎仪，但它们无法检测谎言。

sentences.en: They measure physiological responses to different questions, and an individual's results will depend on many factors.
sentences.zh: 它们测量对不同问题的生理反应，个人的结果将取决于许多因素。

sentences.en: Countermeasures such as controlled breathing and thought exercises can help someone pass a polygraph.
sentences.zh: 诸如控制呼吸和思维练习等应对措施可以帮助某人通过测谎仪。

sentences.en: Likewise, a person who is nervous and emotional may provide responses that the examiner perceives as dishoneSt.
sentences.zh: 同样，一个紧张和情绪化的人可能会提供被审查员认为是虚假的反应。

sentences.en: As Candra Torres' mother later told Forensic Files,
sentences.zh: 正如坎andra·托雷斯的母亲后来对《法医档案》所说的那样，

sentences.en: Polygraphs do not measure truth or lie.
sentences.zh: 测谎仪不测量真相或谎言。

sentences.en: What they measure is emotion.
sentences.zh: 它们测量的是情绪。

sentences.en: And if you were a 16-year-old girl that had been raped, marched up in the mountain, you're talking about your husband that you loved that was shot by this murderer.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个16岁的女孩，曾被强暴、被押解上山，而你谈论的是你深爱的被这个杀人犯枪杀的丈夫。

sentences.en: Would you be emotional?
sentences.zh: 你会情绪激动吗？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想会的。

sentences.en: However, investigators knew that they needed more information if they were to proceed with a murder charge.
sentences.zh: 然而，调查人员知道，如果他们要以谋杀罪起诉，他们需要更多的信息。

sentences.en: They referred Candra to a forensic psychiatrist in the hopes he might be able to shed further light on what had happened.
sentences.zh: 他们将坎andra转介给了一位法医精神病学家，希望他能对发生的事情提供进一步的阐明。

sentences.en: Dr. Joseph Trelevin worked at Oregon State Hospital as head of the psychiatric security unit.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·特雷莱文博士在俄勒冈州立医院工作，担任精神病学安全部门负责人。

sentences.en: He spent several hours interviewing Candra Torres about her ordeal.
sentences.zh: 他花了几个小时面谈坎andra·托雷斯关于她的磨难。

sentences.en: Dr. Trelevin sought to determine why Candra had vehemently defended and supported her rapist and kidnapper, who she knew deep down had gunned down her husband and dog.
sentences.zh: 特雷莱文博士试图确定为什么坎andra会极力辩护和支持她的强奸犯和绑架者，而她内心深处知道这个人枪杀了她的丈夫和狗。

sentences.en: He noted that Candra's early defence of her captor reminded him of stories he had read about American POWs during the Korean War.
sentences.zh: 他指出，坎andra早期对绑架者的辩护让他想起他读过的关于朝鲜战争期间美军战俘的故事。

sentences.en: In situations where these hostages were isolated, tortured, and lived in fear of being killed, they sometimes began to identify with their captor's point of view.
sentences.zh: 在这些为人质者被孤立、遭受酷刑并生活在对被杀害的恐惧中的情况下，他们有时会开始认同绑架者的观点。

sentences.en: Occasionally, they even went so far as to testify against the United States.
sentences.zh: 有时，他们甚至不惜出庭作证指控美利坚合众国。

sentences.en: Those who studied this phenomenon dubbed it brainwashing.
sentences.zh: 那些研究这种现象的人将其称为洗脑。

sentences.en: In 1973, three years before Julio and Candra Torres encountered Tom Brown,
sentences.zh: 1973年，即胡利奥和坎andra·托雷斯遭遇汤姆·布朗的三年前，

sentences.en: it became known as Stockholm Syndrome, after a bank robbery in Sweden where hostages subsequently defended their captors.
sentences.zh: 它被称为斯德哥尔摩综合征，源于瑞典发生的一起银行抢劫案，人质随后为绑架者辩护。

sentences.en: The term made headlines in the US at the start of 1976 when heiress Patty Hurst was trialled for her role in a bank robbery.
sentences.zh: 1976年初，当女继承人帕蒂·赫斯特因涉嫌参与银行抢劫受审时，这个术语登上了美利坚的头条新闻。

sentences.en: Hurst had been abducted in 1974 by a left-wing organisation and was held hostage by them for 19 months.
sentences.zh: 赫斯特于1974年被一个左翼组织绑架，并被他们扣为人质19个月。

sentences.en: While prosecutors claimed Hurst had willingly aligned herself with her captors and agreed to participate in the robbery, her lawyer insisted she had been brainwashed.
sentences.zh: 虽然检察官声称赫斯特自愿与绑架者结盟并同意参与抢劫，但她的律师坚称她被洗脑了。

sentences.en: Some experts in psychology say Stockholm Syndrome occurs when a victim suffers a traumatic shock at the hands of a captor,
sentences.zh: 一些心理学专家表示，当受害者在绑架者手中遭受创伤性休克时，就会发生斯德哥尔摩综合征，

sentences.en: who then isolates them, indoctrinates them, and promises an eventual reward.
sentences.zh: 绑架者随后将他们孤立、灌输思想并承诺最终给予奖励。

sentences.en: In Candra Torres' case, the shooting of Julio and Rusty, along with being repeatedly raped, qualified as traumatic shocks.
sentences.zh: 在坎andra·托雷斯的案子中，枪击胡利奥和拉斯蒂，以及遭受反复强暴，符合创伤性休克的条件。

sentences.en: She was then isolated and indoctrinated by Tom Brown, who repeatedly told her Julio's shooting was an accident.
sentences.zh: 然后她被汤姆·布朗孤立并灌输思想，汤姆反复告诉她枪击胡利奥是一场意外。

sentences.en: Her reward was being released by Tom if she went along with his story.
sentences.zh: 她的奖励是如果她顺从他的说法就会被汤姆释放。

sentences.en: Stockholm Syndrome is not an official psychiatric disorder and does not appear in the DSM-5, a diagnostic manual published by the American Psychiatric Association.
sentences.zh: 斯德哥尔摩综合征不是官方的精神疾病，也没有出现在由美利坚精神医学学会出版的诊断手册《精神疾病诊断与统计手册第五版》中。

sentences.en: Some experts and commentators have criticised the theory of Stockholm Syndrome, pointing out that psychiatrists and psychologists have been unable to reach a consensus on it.
sentences.zh: 一些专家和评论员批评了斯德哥尔摩综合征的理论，指出精神病学家和心理学家未能就此达成共识。

sentences.en: The FBI has described the condition as extremely rare.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局将这种状况描述为极其罕见。

sentences.en: The very case that gave the phenomenon its name is contentious, as police actions in the Stockholm Bank robbery case arguably placed the hostages at greater risk.
sentences.zh: 赋予这一现象名字的这起案件本身就充满争议，因为斯德哥尔摩银行抢劫案中的警方行动可以说置人质于更大的危险之中。

sentences.en: This provides another explanation for why those hostages may have refused to testify against their captors.
sentences.zh: 这为那些人质可能拒绝指证劫持者提供了另一种解释。

sentences.en: Regardless of debate about the condition, Dr Trelevin and investigators came to the conclusion that Candra Torres had allied herself with her abductor as a way to survive.
sentences.zh: 尽管对这种状况存在争议，特雷利温博士和调查人员最终得出结论：坎德拉·托雷斯为了生存，选择与绑架者结盟。

sentences.en: For Candra, the thought that her husband and dog had been killed just because a stranger wanted her to himself was deeply distressing.
sentences.zh: 对坎德拉而言，仅仅因为一个陌生人想独占她就导致丈夫和狗被杀，这种想法让她感到极度痛苦。

sentences.en: She wanted to believe it had all been a tragic accident because then she wouldn't feel guilty about what happened.
sentences.zh: 她宁愿相信这一切只是一场悲剧性的意外，因为这样她就不会为发生的事情感到内疚。

sentences.en: Talking to producers of Forensic Files, Candra said,
sentences.zh: 在接受《法医档案》节目制作人采访时，坎德拉表示，

sentences.en: Although detectives believed Candra's accusations against Tom Brown, they had no way of proving them.
sentences.zh: 尽管侦探们相信坎德拉对汤姆·布朗的指控，但他们无法证明。

sentences.en: Candra's conflicting statements and failed polygraph exam could be used by a defence to undermine her credibility and label her an unreliable witness.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉相互矛盾的陈述和未通过的测谎仪测试，可能会被辩方用来动摇她的可信度，并给她贴上不可靠证人的标签。

sentences.en: Plus, she hadn't seen Tom shoot Julio, she had only heard it.
sentences.zh: 此外，她并没有亲眼看到汤姆开枪打死胡里奥，她只听到了枪声。

sentences.en: They needed physical evidence to prove there had been a murder.
sentences.zh: 他们需要物证来证明发生过谋杀案。

sentences.en: While Candra said Tom shot Rusty from behind, Tom had claimed he shot the dog as the animal ran towards him.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉说汤姆是从背后开枪打死拉斯蒂的，而汤姆则声称他是在狗向他冲过来时开枪的。

sentences.en: If this was true, the bullet would have entered Rusty's head from the front.
sentences.zh: 如果这是真的，子弹应该从前方进入拉斯蒂的头部。

sentences.en: Sheriff's deputies had taken photographs of Rusty's body at the campsite but didn't arrange an autopsy for the dog.
sentences.zh: 治安官副警长在营地拍摄了拉斯蒂尸体的照片，但没有为这条狗安排尸检。

sentences.en: With Rusty long since buried in a mass grave, they had no way of checking which version was true.
sentences.zh: 由于拉斯蒂早已被埋在万人坑中，他们无法核实哪个版本才是真的。

sentences.en: However, they did have some forensics to go on in Julio's case.
sentences.zh: 不过，在胡里奥的案件中，他们确实有一些法医证据可循。

sentences.en: Experts had found no gunpowder residue on Julio's face where the bullet had entered, which indicated that he hadn't been shot at a very close range.
sentences.zh: 专家在胡里奥面部子弹入口处没有发现火药残留物，这表明他不是在极近距离内被枪击的。

sentences.en: In order to find out the minimum distance he could have been shot from, ballistics experts did some tests with Tom Brown's rifle.
sentences.zh: 为了找出他被枪击的最小距离，弹道专家用汤姆·布朗的步枪进行了一些测试。

sentences.en: When fired six inches from its target, it left a visible gunpowder pattern.
sentences.zh: 当在距离目标六英寸处发射时，它留下了清晰的火药痕迹。

sentences.en: The experts tried firing it at gradually increasing distances and discovered that it wasn't until the rifle was fired at least 36 inches from its target
sentences.zh: 专家尝试以逐渐增加的距离进行射击，发现直到步枪距离目标至少36英寸时

sentences.en: that the target remained free from gunpowder.
sentences.zh: 目标才没有沾上火药。

sentences.en: This meant Tom Brown had been a minimum of three feet away from Julio when the rifle went off.
sentences.zh: 这意味着当步枪走火时，汤姆·布朗距离胡里奥至少有三英尺远。

sentences.en: This distance, combined with the almost horizontal entry and exit wound in Julio's head and neck,
sentences.zh: 这个距离，再加上胡里奥头部和颈部几乎水平的进出弹创，

sentences.en: meant Tom's story of an accidental misfire while the gun was being passed between them, didn't hold up.
sentences.zh: 意味着汤姆关于枪支在两人之间传递时意外走火的说法根本站不住脚。

sentences.en: Detectives couldn't arrest Tom Brown as he had gone off the grid after their last interview.
sentences.zh: 侦探们无法逮捕汤姆·布朗，因为他在上次面谈后就已经失联了。

sentences.en: Prosecutors instead took the case to a grand jury to determine whether the death of Julio Torres was a murder or an accident.
sentences.zh: 检察官转而将案件提交给大陪审团，以确定胡里奥·托雷斯的死是谋杀还是意外。

sentences.en: In December 1976, almost five months after Julio was killed, the grand jury reached a decision.
sentences.zh: 1976年12月，在胡里奥遇害近五个月后，大陪审团作出了决定。

sentences.en: Julio had been murdered.
sentences.zh: 胡里奥遭到谋杀。

sentences.en: An indictment was handed down, charging Tom Brown with murder as well as car theft and forgery.
sentences.zh: 一项起诉书随之发出，指控汤姆·布朗犯有谋杀罪以及偷车罪和伪造罪。

sentences.en: Months went by.
sentences.zh: 几个月过去了。

sentences.en: Then, one day, sheriff's deputies were stunned to see Tom walk into their offices.
sentences.zh: 接着，有一天，治安官副警长震惊地看到汤姆走进了他们的办公室。

sentences.en: He looked cool, calm and collected as he approached the front desk and explained that he'd heard there was a warrant out for his arreSt.
sentences.zh: 他走近前台时显得冷静、沉着、镇定，并解释说他听说有对他的逮捕令。

sentences.en: Tom said he was keen to get it all straightened out.
sentences.zh: 汤姆表示他很急切想把事情彻底澄清。

sentences.en: The sheriff's office wasted no time in arresting Tom Brown and charging him with murder.
sentences.zh: 治安官办公室没有浪费时间，立刻逮捕了汤姆·布朗并指控他谋杀。

sentences.en: Then, he was transferred to county jail to await trial.
sentences.zh: 随后，他被转移到县监狱等待审判。

sentences.en: Investigators needed a definitive statement from Candra Torres that they could take to court.
sentences.zh: 调查人员需要坎德拉·托雷斯提供一份可以带上法庭的明确供词。

sentences.en: After encouragement from a criminal investigator, Candra began writing down her memories of her ordeal as they came to mind.
sentences.zh: 在一名刑事调查人员的鼓励下，坎德拉开始把她历险的记忆一一记录下来。

sentences.en: When she was finally finished, she had written 18 pages detailing everything that had happened.
sentences.zh: 当她终于完成时，她已经写了18页，详细记录了发生的一切。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Tom Brown was pleased to discover that his county jail cellmate was a man who he'd previously known as an adolescent at reform school.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，汤姆·布朗高兴地发现他的县监狱同仓犯人是一个他以前在少管所时就认识的少年。

sentences.en: This individual was given the pseudonym Wendell Stokeberry by true crime author Ian Rule
sentences.zh: 犯罪纪实作家伊恩·鲁尔给这个人起了个化名温德尔·斯托克贝里。

sentences.en: Like Tom, Wendell had an extensive criminal background and Tom felt comfortable confiding in him.
sentences.zh: 和汤姆一样，温德尔也有着广泛的犯罪背景，汤姆觉得可以向他倾诉。

sentences.en: He began discussing his upcoming trial, assuring Wendell, quote,
sentences.zh: 他开始讨论他即将到来的审判，并向温德尔保证，原话是：

sentences.en: I'm going to beat it.
sentences.zh: 我一定能打赢这场官司。

sentences.en: Tom openly told Wendell how he had deliberately shot Julio in the face, claiming that he had been hired to murder him.
sentences.zh: 汤姆公开向温德尔讲述了他如何蓄意枪击胡里奥的面部，声称自己是受雇行凶。

sentences.en: Then, he bragged about how he had convinced Candra Torres to go along with his story about an accidental
sentences.zh: 然后，他吹嘘自己是如何说服坎德拉·托雷斯配合他关于意外

sentences.en: shooting and said she wasn't emotionally strong enough to go through with testifying against him.
sentences.zh: 枪击的说法，并称她没有足够的心理承受能力来完成出庭指证他的过程。

sentences.en: A jury wouldn't find her convincing either, Tom said, because she looked older than her actual age and had a seductive demeanour.
sentences.zh: 汤姆说，陪审团也不会觉得她有说服力，因为她看起来比实际年龄老，而且有一种妖艳的举止。

sentences.en: Plus, he had passed a polygraph teSt.
sentences.zh: 此外，他通过了测谎仪测试。

sentences.en: He'd done that by simply choosing to believe in the lies he had invented.
sentences.zh: 他做到这一点的方法，仅仅是选择相信自己编造的谎言。

sentences.en: Tom said that when he was acquitted, he'd kill the case's prosecutors, then go after Candra.
sentences.zh: 汤姆说，当他被判无罪释放时，他要杀掉本案的检察官，然后再去对付坎德拉。

sentences.en: On the off chance that he was convicted, his sentence would probably only be around seven years and he could still get his revenge against Candra upon release.
sentences.zh: 万一他被定罪，他的刑期大概也只有七年左右，他出狱后仍然可以向坎德拉复仇。

sentences.en: Wendell reported everything Tom told him to prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 温德尔把汤姆对他说的一切都报告给了检察官。

sentences.en: They believed Wendell because there were details in his story that no one knew except those with an intimate knowledge of the crimes.
sentences.zh: 他们相信温德尔，因为他的故事中包含了一些细节，除了对犯罪情况有深入了解的人之外，无人知晓。

sentences.en: In exchange for an escape charge removed from his criminal record and a sentence in an out-of-state prison,
sentences.zh: 作为从犯罪记录中抹去逃狱指控并在外州监狱服刑的交换条件，

sentences.en: Wendell agreed to testify against his old friend.
sentences.zh: 温德尔同意指证他的老朋友。

sentences.en: Two days before Tom Brown's trial was set to begin, he managed to source enough money for bail and was released.
sentences.zh: 在汤姆·布朗的审判即将开始的两天前，他设法筹集到了足够的保释金并被释放。

sentences.en: Candra Torres was moved to a motel for her own protection and was kept under 24-hour police guard.
sentences.zh: 为了自身安全，坎德拉·托雷斯被转移到一家汽车旅馆，并受到24小时的警察保护。

sentences.en: The defendant was given the choice of a jury trial or trial by judge and opted for the latter.
sentences.zh: 被告可以选择由陪审团审判或由法官独任审判，他选择了后者。

sentences.en: His former friend Wendell appeared as a witness, as did Dr. Joseph Trelevin, who spoke at length about the phenomenon of Stockholm Syndrome.
sentences.zh: 他的前好友温德尔作为证人出庭，约瑟夫·特雷利温博士也出庭了，他详细讲述了斯德哥尔摩综合征这一现象。

sentences.en: Despite her continuing fear of the man who'd abducted her,
sentences.zh: 尽管她对绑架过她的那个男人依然心存恐惧，

sentences.en: Candra Torres managed to testify at length over one and a half days.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉·托雷斯还是设法进行了长达一天半的详细作证。

sentences.en: Tom Brown also took the stand in his own defence.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·布朗也出庭为自己辩护。

sentences.en: He tried to demonstrate how the alleged accident took place, showing how he'd handed over the rifle to Julio.
sentences.zh: 他试图演示所谓的意外是如何发生的，展示他是如何把步枪递给胡里奥的。

sentences.en: But his demonstration fell flat when it became clear that this handoff was incompatible with the wound that Julio had received.
sentences.zh: 但当人们发现这种交接方式与胡里奥受到的伤不相符时，他的演示便宣告失败。

sentences.en: It took the judge three days to reach a ruling.
sentences.zh: 法官花了三天时间才做出裁决。

sentences.en: He found Tom Brown guilty and sentenced him to life in the Oregon State Penitentiary.
sentences.zh: 他裁定汤姆·布朗有罪，并判处他在俄勒冈州立监狱终身监禁。

sentences.en: Tom Brown has applied for parole a number of times over the ensuing decades, without success.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几十年里，汤姆·布朗曾多次申请假释，但均未成功。

sentences.en: As of early 2022, he remains incarcerated, but he is scheduled to be released in August 2023.
sentences.zh: 截至2022年初，他仍然在押，但预定于2023年8月获释。

sentences.en: He is currently 75 years old.
sentences.zh: 他目前75岁。

sentences.en: The case of Julio and Candra Torres was written about extensively by true crime author Anne Rule.
sentences.zh: 犯罪纪实作家安·鲁尔对胡里奥和坎德拉·托雷斯的案件进行了大量撰文报道。

sentences.en: She detailed the events of their camping trip and the investigation that followed in a chapter of her 2001 book, Empty Promises.
sentences.zh: 在她2001年出版的书籍《空洞的承诺》中的一个章节里，她详细描述了他们的露营之旅以及随后的调查。

sentences.en: Although Candra kept a low profile for many years after her ordeal, in 2020 she shared her story with fellow kidnapping survivor Elizabeth Smart,
sentences.zh: 尽管坎德拉在经历劫难后多年来一直保持低调，但在2020年，她与同为绑架幸存者的伊丽莎白·斯马特分享了自己的故事，

sentences.en: who was abducted from her Utah home in 2002 at the age of 14.
sentences.zh: 后者于2002年在14岁时从犹他州的家中被绑架。

sentences.en: The two women revisited the location where Candra was abducted for an episode of the television series Elizabeth Smart Finding Justice.
sentences.zh: 两位女性重访了坎德拉被绑架的地点，这是电视系列节目《伊丽莎白·斯马特：寻求正义》的一集内容。

sentences.en: It was the first time Candra had been back to Mount Hood National Forest since Julio's murder.
sentences.zh: 这是自胡里奥被害以来，坎德拉第一次重返胡德山国家森林。

sentences.en: She said the visit made her feel empowered.
sentences.zh: 她说这次访问让她感到充满了力量。

sentences.en: Candra Torres is grateful for the physical evidence that helped put her attacker and her husband's killer behind bars.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉·托雷斯对帮助将她的袭击者和丈夫的杀手绳之以法的物证心存感激。

sentences.en: As she told the television program Forensic Files in 2004,
sentences.zh: 正如她在2004年对电视节目《法医档案》所说的那样，

sentences.en: The angle of the shot and the type of gun that was used and the powder burns were all proof that this did not happen the way that he said it did.
sentences.zh: 枪击的角度、所用枪支的类型以及火药残留，都是这一切并非如他所说的那样发生的证据。

sentences.en: So I was very thankful for that evidence.
sentences.zh: 所以我非常感谢那些证据。

sentences.en: Candra eventually remarried, moved far away and started a family.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉最终再婚，搬到了很远的地方并组建了家庭。

sentences.en: She credits psychiatry with helping her recover and understand how her memories were able to be distorted and manipulated by Tom Brown.
sentences.zh: 她将自己的康复归功于精神病学，这帮她认识到自己的记忆是如何被汤姆·布朗歪曲和操纵的。

sentences.en: Candra has found comfort in knowing there is a logical explanation for her reaction to trauma and in having her name publicly cleared.
sentences.zh: 坎德拉感到欣慰的是，她得知自己对创伤的反应有合理解释，并且她的名誉也得到了公开洗刷。
